about: Amp-window test (coordinator, Nov 17 after launch (i)): does the Amp app's window drawing cost the game frame time? Same spot, gate settings, bench and held y0_p0 as the plug-on confirm launch 20261117-105336 (same build: Remix ee695ff, proxy FC8ECC61641E). Five plug-on windows of 45 s in the order as is, minimized, as is, minimized, as is; the only change is ShowWindow minimize / restore of the Amp.exe main window (drive.py live step ampWindow), with a detached watchdog that restores it at a fixed deadline. Each window records and reads back the Amp window's state, rectangle and monitor. Score: python -I tests\analysis\amp_window_score.py <spot folder> (rules fixed in it before the launch: floor 0.626 ms; EFFECT, NO EFFECT, NOT SETTLED, VOID). Exit 0 a verdict, 3 VOID, 1 NOT MEASURED.
